# S1–S2: The CJI quote, the click, collapse and spawn

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S1-S2.md, and do S1–S2. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 242,286p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (S1 and S2). Shared rules: [README.md](README.md).

## Purpose
The quote that names the movement's symbol; the reader clicks "cockroaches", the word collapses into one living roach, and the founder is spawned. One chat because the timed sequence and its reset rule couple the two scenes.

## Allowed data keys
- `meta.cji_quote.{text, speaker, date, keyword, source_id, context_facts}` (text verbatim; `source_id` is null → `[MISSING: cji_quote.source_id]` in the attribution and a GAPS line, as the storyboard shows).
- `meta.founder.{name, founded}` (`founded.attribution`, `founded.value_text`, `founded.claimant` for the `*`). Spelling: **Abhijeet** Dipke.
- `byId.source` for the footer number behind each `*`.

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s01-quote.js`, `src/scenes/s02-spawn.js` (+ their CSS).

## Must not touch
The common list in README. `src/roach/swarm.js` belongs to S0; ask if you need a field.

## Contracts it consumes
- `ctx.controller.lock({ maxMs: 3200 })` / `unlock()`: blocks wheel, touch and scroll keys while the S2 sequence runs; auto-unlocks at `maxMs`.
- Determinism exception (spec §3): the S2 sequence is timed, not scrubbed. It sets a `done` flag. **Scrolling back above S1 p 0.5 resets `done`** and restores the quote (S1's `update(p)` does the reset). A deep link straight to S2 (or later) must render the **done** state.
- S1 auto-triggers at p 0.92 if the keyword hasn't been clicked.
- Prologue layers (`ctx.layers.text` for the quote DOM), `ctx.swarm`, `roach()`.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |
|---|---|---|
| S1 0.50 | Hold, hint showing: quote verbatim; keyword is a `<button class="kw">` (black weight, `--accent-text`, wavy red underline, small roach on the underline); "click the word" above it; swarm behind at 25% opacity, 40% count. | `ink-S1.png` |
| S2 0.30 | After the sequence: quote gone; one roach at `--roach-founder` (s 36) in the lower third; label "**Abhijeet Dipke** is spawned" with `*`, attribution line beneath. Nothing else. | `ink-S2.png` |

## Done when
- The keyword is keyboard (Enter/Space) and mouse operable, visible focus ring, `aria-label` per spec; quote text matches the data exactly.
- Hint at p 0.4; auto-trigger at 0.92; replay works; no scroll desync (scroll is locked ≤ 3.2 s).
- The label fades at S2 p 0.7 and the roach begins to split into S3 (S2 p 1 = S3 p 0).
- QA both ways (the up pass must restore the quote), compare sheets, `qa-shell` all PASS.
